snippet.title: CORE | The Interface
snippet.description:
Understanding the Workings of the Mind and Heart:

Science has proven we record everything through our five senses in our subconscious. When we record things that are traumatic we need permission, safety and new information to change the concepts around what we recorded. This series shows how we can better understand ourselves and how God has made us and to equip us to confront the strongholds.
